title: Anatomy of LLM Sycophancy: What a Flip Rate Hides
abstract: arXiv:2610.06522v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A model under pushback can correct itself, capitulate, or hold, and one flip rate counts a correction and a capitulation alike. SycoLens, a modular replay protocol, measures flip rates from replays of an item, a committed answer, and one scripted user line, each against a matched control with the line deleted. Pushback wording, committed text, answer format, boundary distance, and ground truth become factors of one instrument, where earlier instruments vary one to three, so the interactions between the factors become measurable. Across eleven frontier models and about 760,000 controlled replays, lines that assert the opposite verdict and lines that challenge without asserting one rank the models almost unrelatedly. Flip effects grow several-fold near a model's boundary, yet items the model is certain of still carry about half of the most-affected totals; planted prose anchors a commitment at rest more than it protects it. translated_title: 大语言模型谄媚行为剖析：翻转率掩盖了什么
translated_abstract: 模型在用户反驳下可能自我纠正、妥协让步或坚持立场，而单一的翻转率指标会将“自我纠正”与“谄媚妥协”同等计数。SycoLens 是一种模块化重放协议，通过重放一道题目、一个已提交的答案和一条预先编写的用户台词来测量翻转率，且每次重放都与删除该台词的匹配对照组进行比较。反驳措辞、已提交文本、答案格式、边界距离和真实答案成为同一测量工具中的可控因素（以往工具仅能变化一到三个因素），从而使各因素之间的交互作用变得可测量。在十一个前沿模型和约 76 万次受控重放中，断言相反结论的台词与不作断言、仅提出质疑的台词对模型的排名几乎互不相关。翻转效应在接近模型能力边界时会增长数倍，但模型非常有把握的题目仍占最受影响题目总量的约一半；预先植入的文本对已提交答案在静态下的锚定作用大于其保护作用。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 SycoLens 模块化多因素受控重放协议，对 11 个前沿模型进行约 76 万次重放，首次系统区分并量化了用户反驳下“自我纠正”与“谄媚妥协”这两种被单一翻转率掩盖的行为，并发现断言式与非断言式反驳对模型排名几乎无关、翻转效应在能力边界附近增长数倍、模型高确定题目仍贡献约一半的最严重翻转。
en_tdlr: SycoLens, a modular replay protocol that controls pushback wording, committed text, answer format, boundary distance and ground truth across ~760,000 replays of eleven frontier models, reveals what a single flip rate hides: corrections and sycophantic capitulations are counted alike, assertive and non-assertive pushback rank models almost unrelatedly, and flip effects grow severalfold near the model's boundary.
